value.rationale: The natural invariant physical-time occupation probability answers where orbit time is spent in a global center whose velocity extrema diverge exponentially. A sharp nonzero A^-2 total-variation coefficient, its Clausen closed form on the symmetry axis, and exact sign independence quantitatively distinguish concentration in position from persistent Cauchy velocity fluctuations; this is more informative than period growth alone.
